title: Toast
description: Fiori toast: auto-dismisses after its duration, pauses on hover/focus, nine placements (ui5-toast).

usage.summary: Confirm a completed action or provide information in a non-disruptive message that disappears automatically.
useWhen: Reassure users that an action completed without asking them to respond.
Show information users can understand without leaving their current task.
Adjust duration when needed; the default is 3000 milliseconds and the minimum is 500.

avoidWhen.when: Keep a contextual message visible alongside otherwise usable page content.
Explain an empty or unavailable content area with an illustration and recovery action.
Require an explicit response. Use MessageBox for standard actions, or Dialog for a custom workflow.
Retain business-event updates so users can read, act on or dismiss them later.
